title: unitShots
responsibility: Reads the API-backed pinned Git proof store for one entity and revision, retaining only the reader verdicts and provenance of its original captures.

inputs.name: unitShots.root
inputs.description: Project directory used for external inventory paths or read-only Git evidence access.

inputs.name: unitShots.entity
inputs.description: Exact registered entity identity; a catalog slot prefix for this identity alone can be removed.

inputs.name: unitShots.commit
inputs.description: Exact source commit whose evidence is requested; the proof reader validates tree identity and retained bytes.

outputs.name: unitShots
outputs.description: Captures and evidence gap from the same pinned proof reader used by the screenshot API; missing evidence returns no captures.

errors.name: Dependency failure
errors.description: Propagates Git, filesystem, source-reader and evidence-validation failures from the invoked operation.
